sections.skill: Protect audience trust and diversify platforms and income

questions.prompt: What is a creator's main asset according to the passage?
questions.intro: A creator's main asset is AUDIENCE TRUST: viewers believe the creator is honest and useful. Trust is built by consistent, accurate content, disclosed sponsorships, admitting mistakes, and respecting the audience's time. It is easily lost through hidden ads, misleading claims or low-quality promotions. DIVERSIFICATION means not depending on one platform or income source: an email list, a website, and more than one channel or product reduce the risk of losing everything to one change.

questions.prompt: Labeling ads as ads is like what for a creator?
questions.intro: People trust a local newspaper because it reports accurately, labels ads as ads, and prints corrections. If it hid paid articles as news, readers would stop trusting it. And a newspaper that also has a website and a newsletter is not ruined if one delivery route fails. Creators work the same way: honesty builds trust, and more than one channel spreads risk.
